external_reference_status: Text prompts only: no image was given to the image model or to Meshy. The prompts were written from an owner reference set of 10 images pasted into the Ginkgo session on 2026-10-03 (third-party photographs and artworks, described in runs/refset_1003/pass.json; never uploaded to a generator, not distributed). Note: runs/refset_1003/refs_contact.jpg is a contact sheet of the generated images and decals, not of the owner's references. Design-proximity review 2026-11-20: each generated image was compared with the reference photographs. The soft seat, bladder tank and canister are generic types in different forms and were imported (comparisons in each asset's reference_review); the pack unit and cube rover were excluded as close copies of specific third-party designs, and the lander as a replica of a specific artwork. Provider textures (the colourways that follow the references) are not distributed; only geometry ships.
dimension_basis: Real-world sizes chosen for this import, not the stylised scene sizes: soft seat 0.90 m high (a lounge chair with a tall round backrest; also the height Project Y2K v061 used), bladder tank 0.45 m (a portable collapsible water container with a carry handle; Y2K v061 used 1.35 m and the Ginkgo scenes were larger still), canister 0.65 m (sized as a portable extinguisher-type pressure canister; Y2K v061 used 1.25 m). Each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height; width and depth were measured after scaling. Not a physical survey.
rights: Reference images generated on the owner's Higgsfield account (gpt_image_2_5, text prompts only); meshes with Meshy-7 image-to-3D on the owner's Meshy account (the same account, by the account ID in the result URLs, as the library's other Meshy batches). Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)") and chose this group, Ginkgo props reused in Project Y2K, the same day. The Ginkgo pass records an owner approval on 2026-10-03 that covered generation for the GRANDWHIS world packs, not this library. The prompts were written from third-party reference photographs (see external_reference_status). Generator account entitlements not independently audited. Provider textures are not distributed.
estimated_credits: 0 for this import (generation already paid in Ginkgo: 30 Meshy credits per mesh, Higgsfield image credits)

assets.variant: Low lounge chair with quilted inflatable seat and round back cushions strapped to a bolted perforated-angle, aluminium-extrusion and timber-block frame
assets.prompt: Product-style 3D render of a single original chair, three-quarter view, whole object in frame with margin. A puffy quilted fluorescent yellow-green nylon inflatable cushion seat and round backrest with drawstring gathered edges and yellow elastic cords, strapped onto a low frame made of fluorescent yellow perforated steel angle legs, grey aluminium extrusion rails and pale timber blocks bolted together, a short white corrugated hose and a black carabiner. No text, no logos, no letters, no printing on the fabric. Plain flat light grey studio background, soft even lighting.
assets.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): no lettering, logos or printing on the fabric, frame or blocks. Design proximity: The owner's reference photographs for this pass (10 images pasted into Ginkgo session 280c8dd8 on 2026-10-03; extracted from the transcript to a scratch folder for this comparison only, not retained or distributed) were compared side by side at 800 px with the generated image. The closest reference is a hi-vis inflatable cushion stool on a sawhorse frame of perforated angle and timber, printed with sponsor lettering. The generated chair takes the same material kit (quilted inflatable cushion, perforated angle legs, timber blocks, extrusion, carabiner, hose) but a different form: a low lounge chair with a square seat, a round backrest and four splayed legs, no sawhorse frame and no sack-shaped back. Judged a generic lounge-chair type, not a copy of that piece; the owner should confirm.

assets.variant: Upright quilted collapsible water container with screw cap, carry handle, two webbing straps with buckles and a bottom spout
assets.prompt: Product-style 3D render of a single original soft storage tank, front three-quarter view, whole object in frame with margin. A tall upright translucent frosted white inflatable bladder in the shape of a big jug, crinkled quilted plastic skin, a rigid white screw cap and bail handle on top, wrapped by two wide lime green webbing straps with orange side-release buckles, a small blank dark label plate on the front, a short orange hose tail at the base. No text, no logos, no letters. Plain flat light grey studio background, soft even lighting.
assets.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): a blank dark label patch, no lettering, logos or brand marks. Design proximity: The owner's reference photographs for this pass (10 images pasted into Ginkgo session 280c8dd8 on 2026-10-03; extracted from the transcript to a scratch folder for this comparison only, not retained or distributed) were compared side by side at 800 px with the generated image. The closest reference is a crinkled clear bottle with a narrow neck, green webbing straps, orange buckles and a printed label. The generated container is a square-section jerrycan with a quilted skin, a bail handle and a bottom spout; it shares the strap colourway (texture only, not distributed) but not the form. Generic type.

assets.variant: Upright painted-steel pressure canister with top valve lever, hose and nozzle, two shackles at the valve guard and a blank instruction panel
assets.prompt: Product-style 3D render of a single original industrial pressure canister, three-quarter view, upright, whole object in frame with margin. A weathered light grey painted steel cylinder with a rounded dark base, bolted seams, a top valve assembly with a cast grey lever handle, a curved black rubber hose with a ribbed nozzle, and two chunky safety orange forged shackles clipped through the handle guard. A blank white instruction panel area with only simple abstract pictogram squares, scuffed paint. No text, no letters, no logos. Plain flat medium grey studio background, soft even lighting.
assets.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): the panel carries four simple abstract pictograms (goggles, glove, figure, spray) and no lettering, logos or brand marks. Design proximity: The owner's reference photographs for this pass (10 images pasted into Ginkgo session 280c8dd8 on 2026-10-03; extracted from the transcript to a scratch folder for this comparison only, not retained or distributed) were compared side by side at 800 px with the generated image. The closest reference is a rendered capsule-shaped foam extinguisher with a pistol grip, yellow shackles and printed instructions; the generated canister is an upright cylinder with a lever valve and hose, the common extinguisher type. Generic type.
